value.rationale: Gödel–Dummett prelinearity is a central logical law and satisfiability degree a natural established mathematical invariant. The theorem provides the full exact joint spectrum for all layered weak-order frames and resolves a precise local-versus-global comparison, including universal validity and an extreme asymptotic separation where local axiom degree tends to one but global comparability tends to zero. This is not a mere reparametrization of the universal frame test.
